verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that the CLI can authenticate without a keypair via token-based authentication, and that Cloud Shell comes with credentials pre-configured. Identity domains offer SSO and authentication, but nothing shows OIDC or workload identity federation issuing short-lived credentials to CI pipelines or services. Missing for 10: OIDC/workload identity federation for CI (e.g., GitHub Actions or other external IdP token exchange), short-lived credentials for workloads/services, end-to-end documentation of a keyless pipeline, independent or hands-on corroboration.
